summary: Pre-market view, 2026-10-13. The composite score is 56.71, inside the caution band, the goldilocks regime is unchanged, trend_1d is 2.02 and model confidence is 0.8909. Attribution first: this layer's US leg is the settled 2026-10-12 close, while the previous row in the risk history is an earlier generation of that same 2026-10-12 date, so the 2.02 daily change contains a settlement re-scoring component and must not be read as a new session's move. The overnight story is a second leg down in Asian technology: Korean memory names led the decline, the mainland memory complex weakened with them, and ChangXin Memory closed at 46.99, GigaDevice at 306.22 and Longsys at 271.20. Large US AI names kept falling at the 2026-10-12 close, with Micron -3.8834, AMD -2.2792, Broadcom -1.8836, NVIDIA -1.291 and Tesla -1.2203; 21 of the 22 tracked sectors and themes closed lower, the weakest being networking -4.8175, memory -4.7775 and quantum computing -4.2397, while gaming at +0.2397 was the only gainer. Macro remains the hard constraint, with the macro dimension at 72.57: the 10-year real rate of 2.87 and the 10-year nominal yield of 5.22 both sit at the 99.36 percentile, yet the available rate vintage is 2026-10-08 and is easing. Cross-asset confirmation has risen to 0.75, with 6 of 8 production signals triggered, a contribution of 11.25 that is the model's single largest. The session focus is the opening of third-quarter earnings and the banks, with CPI on 2026-10-14 and PPI plus retail sales on 2026-10-15 as the week's main event risk. Two data reservations apply: the FX input is still frozen at 2026-10-02, and the source daily series is missing its 2026-10-12 bar, which makes the mainland leg's change_1d a two-session move.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation reads 0.75, with 6 of 8 production signals triggered (equity index lower, dollar strength, elevated real rates, bitcoin lower, small-cap underperformance), a single contribution of 11.25 that is the largest in the model and the main mechanical support under the composite score.
The macro dimension scores 72.57 and remains the model's hardest constraint: the 10-year real rate of 2.87 and the 10-year nominal yield of 5.22 both sit at the 99.36 percentile.
Credit is widening: high-yield OAS stands at 3.15 and contributes 5.0992, while investment-grade OAS is unchanged at 0.82, so risk diffusion is not yet confirmed.

Equity structure keeps deteriorating: small-cap relative performance is -9.134 and semis relative performance is -7.5563, while within the 156-name sample the new-lows ratio is 0.1538 against a new-highs ratio of 0.0449.
Overnight reverse repo balances stand at 0.3 and, because the indicator's direction is neutral, a lower reading maps to a higher risk score and contributes 3.8392.

supporting_signals.claim: 21 of the 22 tracked sectors and themes closed lower on 2026-10-12: networking -4.8175, memory -4.7775, quantum computing -4.2397 and semiconductor equipment -3.5576 led the decline; gaming at +0.2397 was the only gainer, followed on resilience by industrial automation -0.0136 and digital advertising -0.0919.
Large US AI names fell in step: Micron -3.8834, AMD -2.2792, Broadcom -1.8836, NVIDIA -1.291 and Tesla -1.2203.
The mainland memory complex closed weaker on 2026-10-13: ChangXin Memory 46.99, GigaDevice 306.22, Longsys 271.20 and Biwin Storage 171.72.

Breadth and trend are not yet broken: the share above the 200-day moving average is 0.5548, price versus the 200-day average is 7.5646 and 3-month momentum is 3.4941, which is why the goldilocks regime holds.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility does not confirm the drawdown: VIX is 14.84, in the 21.11 percentile, realized volatility is 9.797, and the volatility dimension scores 15.93, the lowest of the six dimensions.

On the available vintage rates are easing: the 10-year nominal yield is 5.22 versus a prior 5.28, the 10-year real rate is 2.87 versus 2.92, the 2-year is 4.75 versus 4.77 and the curve spread is 0.47; that vintage is 2026-10-08 and has not absorbed pricing after 2026-10-12.

The dollar leg is frozen at its 2026-10-02 vintage, reading 121.3848, which is the longest-standing data defect in the layer, yet it still feeds the dollar_strength signal behind both the 0.75 cross-asset confirmation reading and the 11.25 largest single contribution.

Today the sector and theme baskets reflect only the 2026-10-12 US session: the source daily series carries no 2026-10-12 bar for the Korean constituents, so the memory basket at -4.7775 is set by its 6 US members alone (mainland constituents are excluded from baskets by design); that reading is not today's Asian memory tape.

The mainland leg's change_1d actually spans the two sessions from 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-13: ChangXin Memory -7.8627, GigaDevice -6.1998, Longsys -4.507 and Biwin Storage -5.1323. The source daily series is missing its 2026-10-12 bar, so these are two-session cumulative moves and must not be read as one-day declines.

The -30.6105 reading for Demingli (001309.SZ) is a price-basis break caused by an ex-rights, ex-dividend date (capital-reserve share conversion combined with a cash dividend), not a market decline; it should be excluded when reading the mainland memory complex.

Confidence is internally inconsistent: the headline 0.8909 (data quality 1.0, coverage 0.93) sits against consistency of only 0.5945, and the score band is missing, with the lower and upper bounds both at 56.71.

what_changed_today: This layer's US leg is the settled 2026-10-12 close, whereas the last published brief (the post-market layer) used a pre-close snapshot of the same session, so the differences between them are snapshot-to-settle, not market revisions.

The composite score is 56.71, with trend_1d at 2.02, trend_1w at 3.35 and trend_1m at 6.28; the previous row in the risk history is an earlier generation of that same 2026-10-12 date, so the 2.02 includes a same-day settlement re-scoring component.
Cross-asset confirmation reads 0.75, with 6 of 8 production signals triggered, contributing 11.25, the largest single contribution in this layer.
21 of the 22 tracked sectors and themes closed lower, the weakest being networking -4.8175, memory -4.7775 and quantum computing -4.2397, with gaming at +0.2397 the only gainer.
Credit widened: high-yield OAS moved from 3.09 to 3.15 while investment-grade OAS held at 0.82.
Neither the rate nor the volatility vintage advanced: rates are still 2026-10-08 (10-year nominal yield 5.22, real rate 2.87, 2-year 4.75) and the VIX vintage is 2026-10-09, reading 14.84.

The mainland leg settled at its 2026-10-13 close (ChangXin Memory 46.99, GigaDevice 306.22, Longsys 271.20), but the source daily series is missing its 2026-10-12 bar, so that leg's change_1d is a two-session move measured from 2026-10-09.
Crypto still diverges from equities: bitcoin 83307, ether 2498.35 and Solana 106.39, with Chinese financial media reporting that bitcoin briefly traded above 84000 intraday.
watch_next: The opening of third-quarter earnings on 2026-10-13: JPMorgan's adjusted revenue missed expectations (509.1 against 513.7, in hundred-million US dollars), Wells Fargo's net interest income also fell short (125.2 against 125.9 on the same basis), and UnitedHealth raised its full-year profit outlook.
CPI on 2026-10-14 is the week's highest-importance event; PPI and retail sales follow on 2026-10-15, the same day TSMC reports.
Whether the weakest links persist: networking and memory led the 2026-10-12 decline and Asian memory stocks fell again overnight, so watch for pass-through into the 2026-10-13 US session.
Whether the theme baskets recover their Asian legs: if the source still lacks a 2026-10-12 daily bar, theme readings will keep reflecting the US session alone.
Whether credit keeps widening: high-yield OAS now sits at 3.15 against a hy_oas_widening trigger level of 4.
Whether the dollar vintage aligns: the FX input has been frozen at 2026-10-02, yet it underpins the largest single contribution of 11.25.
Whether the crypto-equity divergence converges: bitcoin is 83307, with media reporting an intraday break above 84000.
The Fed path: the market-implied rate of 4.075 still points to a hike against an effective federal funds rate of 3.88.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the drawdown stays inside high-valuation AI beta
points: Breadth and trend measures are not broken: 0.5548 of names sit above the 200-day average, price versus the 200-day average is 7.5646 and 3-month momentum is 3.4941, so the goldilocks regime holds.
Volatility eased on the latest vintage: VIX 14.84 and realized volatility 9.797.
Credit has not confirmed diffusion: investment-grade OAS is unchanged at 0.82 and high-yield OAS at 3.15 is still some way from the trigger level of 4.

base_case.title: Base case: caution persists as macro 72.57 and cross-asset 75.0 offset each other
points: The composite score of 56.71 stays in the caution band with the goldilocks regime unchanged; the macro dimension at 72.57 and the cross-asset dimension at 75.0 are the two highest-scoring blocks.
As long as small-cap relative performance stays at -9.134 and the dollar at 121.3848, the 11.25 contribution carried by cross-asset confirmation at 0.75 will persist.
Credit is the swing factor: high-yield OAS at 3.15 against investment-grade OAS at 0.82, a divergence that has not yet converged.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the memory and networking sell-off spreads downstream
points: Within the 156-name sample the new-lows ratio is 0.1538 and the new-highs ratio is 0.0449, a diffusion pattern that is already visible.
If high-yield OAS breaks above the trigger level of 4 from 3.15, it would push the credit dimension at 61.38 higher and erode the offset against the macro dimension at 72.57.
Small-cap relative performance at -9.134 and semis relative performance at -7.5563 show the drawdown has already moved beyond index heavyweights, so further weakness needs no new macro catalyst.
